description: Ruach Studio: The Ultimate YuE2 Studio for local AI music generation. YuE2 Songs Creator, AI Writer, Refiner (30+ nodes, Piano Roll, DAW), Cover Artist, MiniMax H3 Videographer, LoRA Trainer, Librarian. SUNO AI alternative.
summary: A full music studio and WebUI for YuE2 (YuE): songs from words on your own GPU. Score first (ABC/MIDI), LoRA training, stems, remaster, upscale, lyrics check, DAW export. yue2.cpp · 7 languages · OSEM: Open Source, Engaged & Musical
